grade_rationale: 3 P1 findings (exceeds C threshold of max_p1=2). Spec coverage 99.3% is excellent. P1 count driven by 2 RCE-level transitive CVEs and 1 critical tooling misalignment. Grade rebounds to B immediately upon patching DEP-001/DEP-002 and fixing QO-001.
skip_reason: Services offline at audit time — dynamic mode unavailable

escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection & Type Confusion
escalations.impact: Code execution if untrusted templates are compiled; XSS in template output
escalations.fix: npm update handlebars to ≥4.7.9 in Source/Backend

escalations.title: protobufjs Remote Code Execution & DoS
escalations.impact: Remote code execution if orchestrator accepts untrusted protobuf messages; process crashes
escalations.fix: npm update protobufjs to ≥7.5.8 in platform/orchestrator

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer scope is fatally misaligned
p1_findings.detail: The mandatory gate scans only Source/ and E2E/. The portal/ directory (implementing ~80% of FRs) is invisible. Only 13 of ~140 total requirements are validated despite the gate reporting PASSED.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Teams ship unimplemented requirements without detection. The gate creates false confidence in traceability completeness.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add portal/ and platform/ to source_dirs. Add --all-plans flag to loop over all Plans/*/requirements.md files.

p2_findings.title: Route handlers bypass service layer
p2_findings.detail: Three route handlers call store.createWorkItem, store.findById, store.updateWorkItem, store.softDelete directly. CLAUDE.md architecture rule violated.
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/services/workItemService.ts. Route handlers call service functions only.

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed is unimplemented — seed.ts missing
p2_findings.detail: Dependency-linking plan requires idempotent seed data creation. No seed.ts exists. Fresh install cannot satisfy acceptance criteria (BUG-0010 blocked_by 5 items).
p2_findings.recommendation: Create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts per spec. Add seed call to app.ts after migrations.

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer produces false positives on entity IDs
p2_findings.detail: Regex FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ captures entity record IDs in prose (FR-0007 blocked_by FR-0003) as requirement IDs. Also: placeholder IDs (FR-XXX) in 4 requirements files cause permanent false failures.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add enforcer blocklist for FR-0\d{3} pattern. Use backtick notation for entity refs in prose. Remove placeholder IDs.

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp Regular Expression DoS
p2_findings.detail: ReDoS via multiple route parameters causes CPU exhaustion on malformed routes. Orchestrator API becomes unresponsive.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update express in platform/orchestrator (pulls in path-to-regexp fix via express@4.22.2+)

p3_findings.title: FR-070-095 and FR-DUP-01-13 not in Specifications/ (only in Plans/)
p3_findings.detail: 38 requirement IDs for image upload, orchestrator dashboard, and duplicate status tracking are implemented in portal/ but have no entry in Specifications/. Inverts the specs-are-source-of-truth rule.
p3_findings.recommendation: Extend Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md with domain-level coverage for these feature groups.

p3_findings.title: Unexplained eslint-disable suppressions in production frontend
p3_findings.detail: Two eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps with no inline explanation.
p3_findings.recommendation: Add explanatory comment. Audit if dependency should actually be included.

p3_findings.title: uuid Missing Buffer Bounds Check
p3_findings.recommendation: Update uuid to ≥11.1.1 (major version bump, test buffer usage)

p3_findings.title: PostCSS XSS via Unescaped </style>
p3_findings.recommendation: npm update in Source/Frontend (vite update pulls postcss fix)

p3_findings.title: Vite Path Traversal in .map Files (dev server)
esbuild CORS Bypass (Dev-Only)
p3_findings.note: Dev server only; not a production issue
p3_findings.recommendation: Update esbuild via vite major bump

p3_findings.title: vitest/vite-node/mocker Chain Vulnerabilities
p3_findings.recommendation: Update vitest to ≥4.1.7 (major bump, test frontend)

p4_findings.title: DebugPortalPage has no test coverage
p4_findings.recommendation: Add smoke test verifying iframe renders with correct src attribute.

p4_findings.title: 8 packages are ≥1 major version outdated
p4_findings.recommendation: Phase updates: patch first, then minor, then major bumps with full test run per phase.

p4_findings.title: Disproportionate transitive dependency expansion
p4_findings.recommendation: Audit for unused transitive deps. Add npm audit to CI/CD (fail on P1/P2).
